auth.onboardingIntro: Connect your Telegram account to publish stories straight from your browser.
auth.qrInstructions: Open Telegram on your phone, go to Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device, then point your camera at this code.
auth.offlineBody: Your login is saved and has not been removed. The app keeps retrying automatically — or you can retry now.

story.title: Create Story
story.caption: Caption
story.dragDropHint: or drag and drop it here
story.noChannels: No channels or groups found where you can post stories.
story.selectAtLeastOneTarget: Choose at least one place to post to.
story.chooseMediaFirst: Choose a photo or video first.
story.keepOnProfileHint: After it expires, the story stays visible on your profile.
story.protectContentHint: Viewers can't take screenshots, save or forward this story.
story.protectContentLocked: This can't be changed after posting.

history.title: History
history.pinnedDone: The story will stay on your profile.
history.unpinned: The story was removed from your profile.
history.expiredNoEdit: Telegram only lets you edit stories that are still active.

errors.storiesTooMuch: You've reached Telegram's active Story limit.
errors.phoneNumberInvalid: That phone number doesn't look right.
errors.phoneCodeExpired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to upload.
errors.floodWait_one: You can try again in {{count}} second.
errors.floodWait_other: You can try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.loadAccountInfoFailed: Couldn't check your account details — captions and story duration options may be off until this loads.
errors.loadChannelsFailed: Couldn't load your channels and groups — only your personal story is available right now.
errors.missingApiCredentials: No Telegram API credentials are set up yet. Add your own below, or (for local builds) set VITE_TELEGRAM_API_ID/VITE_TELEGRAM_API_HASH in .env.local and rebuild.
errors.connectionTimeout: Couldn't reach Telegram's servers in time. Check your connection and try again.

sessionEnded.title: You're logged out of Telegram
sessionEnded.reason: Telegram ended this login session. It was closed from another device (Settings → Devices), expired, or revoked.
sessionEnded.fix: Log in again with your phone number or a QR code. Scheduled stories will publish once you're back.

keyDuplicated.title: This login was invalidated
keyDuplicated.reason: The same Telegram session was used from two places at the same time, so Telegram cancelled it for safety.
keyDuplicated.fix: Log in again, and keep only one Story Publisher window active at a time.

accountDeactivated.title: This Telegram account is unavailable
accountDeactivated.reason: Telegram reports the account as deleted or banned.
accountDeactivated.fix: Check the account in the official Telegram app or contact Telegram support.

storyLimitActive.title: Too many active stories
storyLimitActive.reason: Telegram allows only a limited number of active stories at once, and you've reached it.
storyLimitActive.fix: Delete an active story or wait for one to expire, then try again.

storyFlood.title: Story posting limit reached
storyFlood.reason: Telegram limits how many stories an account can post per week (limit: {{n}}).
storyFlood.reasonMonthly: Telegram limits how many stories an account can post per month (limit: {{n}}).
storyFlood.fix: Wait until the limit resets, or use an account with Telegram Premium for higher limits.

periodInvalid.title: That story duration isn't allowed
periodInvalid.reason: Only Telegram Premium accounts can choose a duration other than 24 hours.
periodInvalid.fix: Pick 24 hours, or use a Premium account.

premiumRequired.title: Telegram Premium is required
premiumRequired.reason: This action is only available to Telegram Premium accounts.
premiumRequired.fix: Choose a different option, or upgrade the account in the Telegram app.

boostsRequired.title: This channel needs more boosts
boostsRequired.reason: A channel must reach a certain boost level before it can post stories.
boostsRequired.fix: Boost the channel in Telegram, or post to a different target.

noPermission.title: You can't post here
noPermission.reason: Your account isn't allowed to post stories in this channel or group — the 'Post stories' admin right is missing or you're restricted.
noPermission.fix: Ask an owner to give you that admin right, or remove this target.

targetUnavailable.title: This channel or group isn't available
targetUnavailable.reason: Telegram can't find it — it may have become private, been deleted, or you left it.
targetUnavailable.fix: Remove this target, or rejoin the channel and try again.

storyGone.title: This story no longer exists
storyGone.reason: It was deleted or it expired and was removed from Telegram.
storyGone.fix: Reload your history to see the current list.

notModified.title: Nothing was changed
notModified.reason: Telegram received the same content, audience and settings the story already has.

captionTooLong.title: The caption is too long
captionTooLong.reason: The caption is longer than your account's limit.
captionTooLong.fix: Shorten the caption (Premium accounts get a higher limit).

mediaTooBig.title: The file is too large
mediaTooBig.reason: Telegram rejected the upload because the file is bigger than the allowed size.
mediaTooBig.fix: Use a shorter or smaller video, or a lower-resolution photo.

mediaUnsupported.title: This file can't be used as a story
mediaUnsupported.reason: Telegram doesn't accept this photo or video format or codec.
mediaUnsupported.fix: Use a JPG or PNG photo, or an MP4 (H.264) video.

photoInvalid.title: The photo couldn't be processed
photoInvalid.reason: Telegram refused the photo because of its size, dimensions or encoding.
photoInvalid.fix: Re-save it as JPG, or zoom or crop it in the editor so it is re-rendered, then try again.

audienceInvalid.title: The audience selection is invalid
audienceInvalid.reason: Telegram rejected the list of people who may see the story or who it's hidden from — there are too many, or one of them isn't valid.
audienceInvalid.fix: Reduce the selection or pick the people again, then retry.

audienceUnresolved.title: Some selected people weren't found
audienceUnresolved.reason: {{n}} of the selected people are no longer in your contacts, so Telegram can't be told who they are.
audienceUnresolved.fix: Open the audience picker and select the people again.

apiCredentials.title: The API credentials were rejected
apiCredentials.reason: Telegram refused this api_id / api_hash — it is invalid, or too many accounts used the same pair.
apiCredentials.fix: Create your own pair at my.telegram.org/apps and enter it in Settings → API connection.

phoneBanned.title: This phone number is banned
phoneBanned.reason: Telegram has banned this number from logging in.

phoneFlood.title: Too many login attempts
phoneFlood.reason: Telegram has temporarily blocked login attempts for this number.
phoneFlood.fix: Wait a few hours before trying again.

floodWait.title: Telegram asks you to slow down
floodWait.reason: Too many requests were sent in a short time.
floodWait.fix: Try again after the wait ends.

serverError.title: Telegram had a temporary problem
serverError.reason: Telegram's servers returned an internal error.
serverError.fix: Wait a moment and try again.

network.title: Can't reach Telegram
network.reason: The network connection failed or was interrupted. You are still logged in.
network.fix: Check your internet connection (and any VPN or proxy), then retry.

connectionTimeout.title: Telegram took too long to answer
connectionTimeout.reason: No response arrived in time — usually a slow or blocked connection. You are still logged in.
connectionTimeout.fix: Check your internet connection (and any VPN or proxy), then retry.

sessionBusy.title: Another window is using your account
sessionBusy.reason: Another Story Publisher window or a scheduled post is using the Telegram connection right now.
sessionBusy.fix: Wait a few seconds or close the other window, then retry.

missingApi.title: API credentials are missing
missingApi.reason: No Telegram api_id / api_hash is configured.
missingApi.fix: Add your own in Settings → API connection (get them at my.telegram.org/apps).

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.reason: Telegram returned an error this app doesn't recognize yet.
unknown.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, include the error code below when you report it.

schedule.publishAtHint: Posted automatically at this time — you don't need the extension open.
schedule.mustBeFuture: Pick a time at least a minute from now.
schedule.needsLoginTitle: {{count}} scheduled stories need you to log in
schedule.needsLoginBody: Your Telegram session expired, so these can't publish automatically until you log in again.
schedule.needsExtensionContext: Scheduling only works when this is loaded as a real extension (chrome://extensions), not when running as a plain dev-server tab.

apiCredentials.title: API connection
apiCredentials.usingDefault: Using the app's shared default credentials.
apiCredentials.logoutWarning: Saving this logs you out — you'll need to log in again under the new credentials.
apiCredentials.invalidId: api_id should be just the number from my.telegram.org/apps.
apiCredentials.invalidHash: api_hash should be the 32-character code from my.telegram.org/apps.

mediaEditor.hint: Drag to move · scroll or pinch to zoom · double-click to toggle zoom
mediaEditor.videoNote: Zoom, crop and adjust work on photos. Videos are posted as they are.

audience.canSelectedNone: nobody yet — choose at least one contact.
audience.cantNonCloseFriends: everyone who isn't a Close Friend.
audience.cantHidden: the people you hid it from ({{n}}): {{names}}.
audience.channelAll: Channel stories are visible to everyone who can view the channel's stories — there is no audience choice.
audience.unknown: Telegram didn't report who can see this story.
audience.unknownEdit: The current audience couldn't be read, so it stays as it is unless you pick a new one.

viewers.hiddenFrom: Your stories are hidden from them
